name: Video-to-3D Mocap Studio (multi-person, Blender/FBX export)
summary: Local tool that turns ordinary video of one or several people into 3D motion capture: YOLOv11-pose + BoT-SORT tracking, 3D joint solve, inferred legs when the lower body is out of frame, temporal smoothing, and export of skinned mannequins with a 59-joint Mixamo-compatible rig as FBX/.blend plus BVH/NPZ motion.

access.notes: Repo code MIT, but it depends on ultralytics (AGPL-3.0) for pose detection, which constrains commercial distribution. README mostly in Chinese.

procedure: pip install -r requirements.txt (Python 3.10+, Blender 3.6-5.x for export)
Run the web app (app.py) or cli.py on a video
Export FBX/.blend mannequins and BVH/NPZ motion

verdict.why: Promising feature set and MIT code, but repo created Nov 4 with 1 star and no independent test yet; AGPL ultralytics dependency. Held until it gets traction or a test.
